references.finding: Table wraps AcDbTable; native API supports table style, size, dimensions, placement, and cell text/block content.
GenerateLayout computes geometry from definition/style; posting/closing creates the table block.
Database.SaveAs accepts DwgVersion.AC1024 for AutoCAD 2010 DWG.
DxfOut precision -1 selects Binary DXF; ordinary nonnegative precision writes ASCII DXF.
AutoCAD 2024 Table.SetBlockTableRecordId(row,column,contentIndex,blockId,autoFit) selects a block BTR for a specific cell content; Autodesk marks this overload obsolete.
AutoCAD 2024 Table.SetBlockAttributeValue(row,column,attributeDefinitionId,value) sets the selected block cell attribute; Autodesk marks this overload obsolete.
AutoCAD 2024 managed guide documents creating AttributeDefinition objects inside a BlockTableRecord and setting tag, prompt, default text, height, and attribute modes.

references.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
references.finding: For block cell content, H/340 is a hard pointer to the block record; BL/91 is the attribute count; each attribute uses H/330 as a soft pointer to ATTDEF, TV/301 as its value, and BL/92 as a one-based index.

apiResearch.sourceType: Official Autodesk managed API documentation and ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 §20.4.97
apiResearch.limit: The ObjectARX API binds the authored semantic state, and ODA supplies the expected field roles; neither alone establishes this producer file’s serialized bit spans, actual handle codes, boundary alignment, independent semantics, or support qualification.
